scope: Art-only; no repository code, original asset, active RC5 atlas, main pages, or runtime file changed.

calls.assessment: The first board had a swordless body and detached arm pair, but they were too three-quarter/front-facing and the hands did not read as a two-handed sword grip.

alpha_byte_ge_6.note: The three main parts are disconnected. Many small faint alpha specks remain outside the main components.

visual_landmark_estimates.basis: Rough visual estimates from the actual PNG; not automated landmark detection. The source image is still three-quarter rather than a true side profile, so the far shoulder estimate is especially uncertain.

final_candidate.visual_assessment: The final board preserves the black-haired male, black/red armor, red cracks and torn cape. It has a swordless body and two separately disconnected arm components. However, the body remains three-quarter/front-facing rather than matching the active RC5 right-facing side profile. Both arm hands are closed fists, not a clear grip around an absent sword handle; the arms are similar duplicates arranged vertically. The candidate is a usable separated-layer concept, but it does not fully satisfy the side-profile and hand-grip requirements. Two calls were used; no further generation was performed.
